scripts.wasm: npm run wasm:st && npm run wasm:mt
scripts.wasm:st: RUSTFLAGS='-C target-feature=+simd128' wasm-pack build solver --release --target web --out-dir pkg
scripts.wasm:mt: RUSTFLAGS='-C target-feature=+atomics,+bulk-memory,+mutable-globals,+simd128 -C link-arg=--shared-memory -C link-arg=--max-memory=4294967296 -C link-arg=--import-memory -C link-arg=--export=__wasm_init_tls -C link-arg=--export=__tls_size -C link-arg=--export=__tls_align -C link-arg=--export=__tls_base' rustup run ${RUST_NIGHTLY:-nightly} wasm-pack build solver --release --target web --out-dir ../public/solver-mt -- --features mt --target-dir solver/target-mt -Z build-std=panic_abort,std && node solver/patch-mt.mjs
